entities.summary: Kadınhanı is a municipality and district of Konya Province, Turkey. Its area is 1,568 km2, and its population is 31,206 (2022). Its elevation is 1,126 m (3,694 ft). The current name of the town refers to a certain female commissioner of a caravanserai in the town, whereas the town was known historically by its Greek name of Pithoi.
